description: Election Commission - The names and addresses of Election Agents of the Presidential Election
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice under Section 31(3) of the Presidential Elections Act, No. 15 of 1981, specifically publishing the names and addresses of Election Agents appointed for candidates in the 2019 Presidential Election. It directly concerns electoral processes, candidate nominations, and election administration, fitting perfectly within the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which covers election announcements, candidate registrations, and electoral commission matters.
